Troubleshooting ​

Common errors, what they mean, and the fix.

Setup ​

ErrorCauseFix
could not find driverpdo_mysql not enabledenable extension=pdo_mysql in php.ini (php --ini shows which file)
SQLSTATE[HY000] [1045] Access deniedwrong DB_USERNAME / DB_PASSWORDfix .env, then php artisan config:clear
SQLSTATE[HY000] [1049] Unknown databasedatabase not createdCREATE DATABASE ... (see Configure the environment)
No application encryption key has been specifiedempty APP_KEYphp artisan key:generate
laravel: command not foundComposer's global bin not in PATHadd it to PATH, or use composer create-project
Changes to .env ignoredconfig is cachedphp artisan optimize:clear

Database ​

ErrorCauseFix
1067 Invalid default value for 'expires_at'a required timestamp() column on a MySQL server with explicit_defaults_for_timestamp=OFFuse dateTime() for required time columns
1452 Cannot add or update a child row: a foreign key constraint failsinserting a row that points at a missing parentseed/create the parent first; check seeder order
1451 Cannot delete or update a parent rowdeleting a row that others still reference (restrictOnDelete)delete or detach the children first, or soft delete
Base table or view not foundmigration not run, or wrong migration orderphp artisan migrate:status; parent tables need older timestamps
Column not found ... order clausea sort key reached SQLadd an allow-list in implementSort()

Authentication ​

SymptomCauseFix
Login: REFRESH_TOKEN_PEPPER is not setmissing peppergenerate it (see Refresh sessions), then config:clear
JWT key not found at ...keys not generated or wrong pathgenerate the key pair; check JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
Login / refresh: 403 Request origin is not allowedfrontend origin not trustedadd it to AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS (and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS)
Login / refresh: 403 Missing required X-Requested-With headercalled from Postman/curl without an Originsend X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
Every call 401 right after loginrequest has no Authorization: Bearer header, or Accept missing so a redirect happenedsend both headers
Refresh always 401 refresh_missingcookie not sentfrontend must use credentials: 'include'; the call must go to /api/v1/auth/... (cookie path)
Refresh 409two tabs refreshed at onceretry the original request; don't log out
Users logged out after deployingpepper or keys changedexpected; keep them stable per environment
Auth guard [api] is not defined / driver jwt not supportedAuthServiceProvider not registeredadd it to bootstrap/providers.php

Permissions ​

SymptomCauseFix
403 You do not have permission to ...the user's group lacks itgrant it in data/rbac.php + seed, or through PUT /user-groups/{id}/permissions
New sub-module never grantedname typo between routes and seed datause the SubModules constants; the seeder stops on unknown names
Admin gets 403admin's user_role_id isn't 1check UserRoles::ADMINISTRATOR matches the seeded id

Browser / frontend ​

SymptomCauseFix
Console: blocked by CORS policyorigin not allowed, or credentials with *exact origins in config/cors.php, supports_credentials: true
Blade form: 419 Page Expiredmissing @csrf or the session expiredadd @csrf; reload the page
Blade: Vite manifest not foundassets not builtnpm run dev (local) or npm run build
API returns an HTML pageerror without Accept: application/jsonsend the header; shouldRenderJsonWhen (step 03) covers /api/*

Where to look ​

  1. The response message (full details when APP_DEBUG=true).
  2. storage/logs/laravel.log.
  3. The activity log (every 5xx is recorded with its payload).
  4. php artisan route:list -v for routes and their middleware.
  5. php artisan tinker to try queries and services directly.
